name: financecheck-ai-naail
description: Public/synthetic-only finance and accounting education: claim verification, reconciliations, SOX draft workpapers, statements, variance, descriptive data checks, SQL syntax safety and educational valuation. Human approval required.

interface.shortDescription: Understand and check public financial statements and accounting numbers
interface.longDescription: Original finance and accounting workflow skills, privacy and independent reviewer gates, synthetic arithmetic, illustrative valuation, and optional licensed-market-data templates. NO LIVE ERP, KENSHO, WAREHOUSE OR PRIVATE DRIVE CONNECTORS. No SOX/IFRS attestation or investment recommendations.
defaultPrompt: Check an annual-report claim against a primary public filing with a source and fiscal period.
Explain a fictional journal entry and reconciliation.
Review a fictional discounted cash flow with uncertainty.
